name: ThreeSum1960614_Machine_Bundle040
definition_title: Original-input wanted host, persistent allocations, and hybrid runtime budgets
natural_language_statement:
This bundle defines the concrete selected-color and wanted-record hosts together with their resource contracts. A color law specifies that, from the original integer input segment and the actual parameter and color records, a selected-color program returns a Boolean verdict equivalent to the corresponding color witness and preserves memory before the color row. The wanted host reads every scan control from the retained parameter, normalization, encoding, and reporting headers.

Persistent-end predicates bound each individual retained array, source-band header, histogram, occurrence row, coefficient table, and source-stage family before the mutable counter. They keep the two chosen bands independent. Uniform readiness at magnitude exponent $k\in\mathbb N$ requires positive input size and microblock half-size, radix at least $4$, the actual divisor-budget inequality, and separation of every nonzero integer of absolute value at most $3n^k$ by some generated auxiliary prime. The bundle includes an eventual cutoff satisfying these conditions before the input arrays are chosen.

The full fast driver initializes a nineteen-cell parameter record and a reusable six-cell color row, then scans the complete coloring family. Need records give relative word, cell, and depth reservations for dense setup, reporting setup, source preparation, the selected-color allocation, and the physical wanted scan. The guard-sensitive slot budget keeps the active-branch mass charge inside the cumulative threshold test.

For fixed exponent $k$, cutoff $N$, input size $n$, and supplied magnitude $U$, the hybrid cost selects the original triple-scan cost when $n<N$ or $n^k<U$, and otherwise selects the complete fast-driver cost, including integer exponentiation and caller overhead. The encoded-color reporting pipeline composes the actual source construction with reporting and dense initialization while retaining the original normalized witnesses.

These definitions provide the uniform readiness, exact physical loading, affine memory accounting, and finite-exception runtime interface needed by the complete deterministic integer 3SUM proof.

name: ThreeSum1960614_Machine_Bundle041
definition_title: Complete original-input 3SUM solver and its exact finite-cutoff hybrid
natural_language_statement:
This bundle assembles the concrete deterministic integer 3SUM solver. The wanted-consumer interface labels each physical record by its original incidence and global output, defines its original fiber, root mass, terminal-hit predicate, and guard-sensitive execution time, and follows the frozen ascending order of the actual pair array. The threshold is the representation cap multiplied by the false score of the actually selected common modulus.

For one selected color, the program executes the complete encoding-and-reporting prelude, reads its retained counter pointer, and invokes the physical wanted scan. Its relative resource record combines persistent prelude storage with reused scratch. The complete fast solver then initializes parameters and scans every coloring; it has $537$ procedures and uses the resulting selected-color correctness law.

For fixed magnitude exponent $k\in\mathbb N$ and cutoff $N\in\mathbb N$, the hybrid caller first tests the actual size $n$. If $n<N$, it invokes the exact original-position triple scan. Otherwise it computes $n^k$; it again uses the triple scan when the supplied input bound $U$ exceeds that value, and uses the fast solver in the remaining case. Both branches reuse the same free address. The hybrid need record reserves the larger branch cell and depth requirements and includes the actual scalar controls and intermediate powers in its word requirement.

The final program chooses $N$ from the proved uniform readiness conditions for $k$. Its $543$ procedures comprise the fast library, relocated four-procedure triple solver, integer-power procedure, and hybrid caller. The associated need and time functions apply at every size and supplied magnitude, including zero. The intended decision concerns three distinct original positions and preserves all memory before the supplied free address.

These definitions are the final executable assembly used to connect the complete runtime analysis to the exact word-RAM end statement.
